driver_archetypes.rationale: Standard compliant car behavior. Increased share to 0.93 and reduced early-start probability (via low lcImpatience=0.2) to lower the M2/early/car simulation value towards the target (~0.011). Reduced tau slightly to improve discharge headway.
Highly impatient car archetype to match M2/early/car observed share (~0.011). High lcImpatience (0.9) drives early creep probability up for this small sub-population.
Standard compliant motorcycle behavior targeting M1/moto discharge headway (observed mean 0.2957s) and reducing overshoot depth by aligning to the right side of the lane.
Slow motorcycle archetype to replicate M4/lat_moto (lateral position ~7m from origin) and M4/overshoot_share metrics by riding in lane center with slower acceleration.

Violating motorcycle archetype (custom1) that joins the 'moto_violator' distribution to model illegal left turns from HDT_N/S and queue seeking behaviors (M8/moto wrong-lane share). High lcSublane pushes vehicle into adjacent lanes.

traci_rules.rationale: Sets moderate early start creep window and probability for cars to match M2/early/car share (target ~0.011). The low p ensures the weighted sum matches the observation.

Enables red-light running for standard motorcycles to match M3/share/moto (target ~0.098). Increased p0 from 0.15 to 0.25 boosts the base probability closer to observation, leveraging the swarm effect k.
Adds extra hold time for illegal left-turning motorcycles to match M6/approach/l/moto entry timing (target ~53.58s) and reduce excessive holding times seen in previous iterations.

description: Adjusted archetype shares: increased compliant car share (0.93) and slow-moto share (0.7) to lower early-start violations and queue lengths. Increased swarm red-running p0 for motorcycles to match the observed violation rate. Kept illegal-left hold times moderate.
